description: A SIGN clause without SEPARATE CHARACTER in a REPORT GROUP description entry (kb/Work PB3683). ANSI X3.23-1985 required the SEPARATE phrase there; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 123 QUOTES the change: 'SIGN clause in a report description entry. The SEPARATE phrase is no longer required in a report description entry and the SIGN clause may be specified at the group level.' (item 115's bullet: 'SIGN clause does not require SEPARATE phrase in report section'). The 2023 text of 13.18.52.4 GR5 gives the clause without SEPARATE an implementor-defined representation and 13.18.52.3 SR1 admits 'a numeric report group description entry whose picture character-string contains the symbol S'. Gated in ONE place, DataBinder.ScreenReportSignClauses (once per written entry).
display: a SIGN clause without SEPARATE CHARACTER in a report group description entry
vcr: VCR row 7.40 (85->2002: a report group entry's SIGN clause no longer requires SEPARATE CHARACTER)
